subject: general
question: Which of the following are building blocks of proteins?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amino acids**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Amino acids** are organic compounds that serve as the building blocks of proteins in living organisms.
 
• Proteins are formed through the polymerization of amino acids via **peptide bonds**, creating long chains known as polypeptides.
 
• There are **20 standard amino acids** commonly found in proteins, which include essential and non-essential amino acids.
 
• **Essential amino acids** cannot be synthesized by the body and must be obtained through diet, whereas non-essential amino acids can be produced internally.
 
• Amino acids play crucial roles in various biological functions, including enzyme activity, cellular structure, and metabolic processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Peptide Bond**: A chemical bond formed between two amino acids when the carboxyl group of one reacts with the amino group of another, releasing a molecule of water.
 
• **Protein Structure Levels**: Proteins have four structural levels—primary (sequence of amino acids), secondary (alpha-helices and beta-sheets), tertiary (three-dimensional structure), and quaternary (arrangement of multiple polypeptides).
 
• **Role of Proteins**: Proteins function as enzymes, hormones, antibodies, transport molecules, and structural components in cells and tissues.
 
• **Metabolic Pathways**: Amino acids are precursors for important biomolecules like neurotransmitters, nucleotides, and nitrogen-containing compounds.
 
• **Protein Synthesis**: The process involves transcription (DNA to mRNA) and translation (mRNA to protein), utilizing ribosomes and tRNA for the assembly of amino acids.
